verdict.rationale: Vercel Sandbox is mainly an isolated execution environment for running agent-generated code, not a product with its own built-in assistant. The only relevant evidence is that the default `vercel/sandbox/universal` image ships with preinstalled "coding agents" (docs-34), so a user could delegate tasks to an agent inside a sandbox. Nothing describes a first-party assistant in the dashboard, CLI or SDK. Missing for 10: a documented first-party built-in AI assistant, details on which coding agents are included and how tasks are delegated to them, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
